Players Committee errata sheet slip of [[F-11D Blaster Rifle (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploy on your First Order warrior. May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Add 1 if fired by a stormtrooper. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny > defense value.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/december2019errata.pdf#page=1 december2019errata.pdf], page 1 (PDF dated 6 December 2019). Rendered from the PDF at 300 dpi and cropped to the slip with its title label; no other edits.
